title: Idea 1: PBVE‑lite on PCA(60) before vanilla kNN(k=50) — per‑batch PC variance equalization
abstract: Equalize per-batch per-PC variances to the global variance in PCA space before building a vanilla kNN graph (k=50, cosine). Hypothesis: reduces batch‑anisotropy without quotas/residualization.
